subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2833
title: Expands the application of a law requiring law enforcement officers working in crowd management to wear certain identification to crowd management in a city with a population of over 5,000, instead of 60,000.
headline: HB 2833 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2833 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2833 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
